title: Avoid SERIAL data type uppercase allocation
description: Replace SERIAL default candidate type matching's to_ascii_uppercase allocation with an ASCII case-insensitive helper.

criteria: SERIAL default candidate detection no longer allocates uppercase data type strings
SERIAL, SERIAL2, SERIAL4, SERIAL8, SMALLSERIAL, and BIGSERIAL remain recognized

notes: The helper trims the data type and uses eq_ignore_ascii_case for each supported serial alias.
serial_default_candidate_column_indexes still returns the same candidate indexes.
Serial default value generation and row scanning are unchanged.
